svg.title: Home SOC and Purple Team Lab Architecture — 17 Systems
svg.desc: Current segmented home SOC and Purple Team lab architecture. Seventeen systems include pfSense and sixteen hosts. ZEEK01 uses a VMnet3 management interface and a no-IP passive VMnet6 sensor interface with partial visibility.
